infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Mcare+ uses the camera to take photos of your prescriptions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Mcare+ lets you upload prescription photos from your gallery.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Mcare+ uses your location to find pharmacies that deliver to you.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Mcare+ listens when you tap the microphone so you can set reminders and order medicines by voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Mcare+ turns your voice into text so you can set reminders and order medicines by speaking.
